name: cgc-tag-list
description: Quartz 5 component: a page's tags as badges, each ringed in its tag's colour from the cgc-tags engine. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the component's vnodes must be the host's Preact's. The types are imported for types only.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, inlining our library, and PostCSS checks the stylesheet against ADR-0003 before it ships (build.mjs). The library is a `file:` spec on main, which a release commit rewrites to the release's published version (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-tag-list
quartz.description: A page's tags as badges, each ringed in its tag's colour from the cgc-tags engine.
